sections.title: Who this notice is for
sections.body:
This notice explains how World Championship of Legends (WCL) handles information in connection with this public website and enquiries sent to WCL. For website privacy questions, contact [info@wclcricket.com](mailto:info@wclcricket.com).

It covers browsing, saved website preferences and the contact form. Ticket sellers, external social platforms and any separate accreditation or staff application have their own notices. Read the notice shown by that service before submitting information there.

sections.title: Information we handle
sections.body:
- **Enquiries:** the name, email address, enquiry topic and message you submit, your acknowledgement of this notice, a submission reference and any subsequent correspondence.
- **Website preferences:** your chosen team and saved video identifiers are stored in your browser when you choose those features. The website does not create a fan account from these choices.
- **Technical information:** hosting and security services may process your IP address, browser and device information, request times, requested pages and security signals to deliver and protect the service.

Please only provide information needed for your enquiry. Do not send card details, passwords, passport copies, medical information or confidential information about another person through this form.

sections.title: How and why it is used
sections.body:
Enquiry information is used to understand your request, direct it to the appropriate WCL team and respond. Technical information supports website delivery, fault diagnosis and abuse prevention. Your browser preferences provide the team and video-saving features you select.

Where a law requires a lawful basis, responding to an ordinary enquiry and keeping the website secure may rely on legitimate interests; steps you request before entering an agreement may rely on that purpose; and some records may be needed to meet legal obligations. If consent is needed for an additional purpose, it must be requested separately. A privacy acknowledgement is not marketing consent.

This contact form does not subscribe you to a mailing list, take payments or make automated decisions about you with legal or similarly significant effects.

sections.title: Services and sharing
sections.body:
Information may be accessed by WCL personnel who need it to handle your request and service providers supporting the website. The contact service uses Vercel for hosting, Resend for email delivery and Cloudflare Turnstile for spam prevention when online enquiries are enabled. Messages are addressed to WCL’s enquiry mailbox, not published on the website.

These providers may process information in countries other than your own. Applicable protections and transfer arrangements depend on WCL’s provider contracts and deployment settings. Information may also need to be disclosed where required by law or to protect legitimate legal rights.

YouTube supplies video thumbnails and players. Maps and social links connect to their respective providers. Those providers receive technical information when their content loads or you visit their services. See [Cookies & storage](/cookies) for how these features work.

Provider notices: [Vercel](https://vercel.com/legal/privacy-policy), [Resend](https://resend.com/legal/privacy-policy), [Cloudflare](https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/) and [Google / YouTube](https://policies.google.com/privacy).

sections.title: Keeping information safe
sections.body:
The form does not create a separate contact database in this website. Enquiries pass through the delivery service to WCL’s mailbox. Mailbox correspondence and delivery or security records may remain after submission.

Retention depends on the purpose and progress of your enquiry, any continuing relationship, applicable legal requirements and the need to resolve disputes. Hosting and delivery logs also follow the relevant service settings. You can ask about the records held for your enquiry or request deletion using [info@wclcricket.com](mailto:info@wclcricket.com).

Access controls, server-side validation and security checks help protect the service. No internet transmission or storage system is completely secure. Do not use the form for sensitive or urgent security information. Browser preferences remain until you clear them or your browser removes site data.

sections.title: Your choices and rights
sections.body:
Depending on the law that applies to you, you may have rights to access, correct, delete or receive a copy of your personal information, restrict processing, object to certain uses or withdraw consent where processing relies on it. These rights can be subject to legal exceptions.

Send a request to [info@wclcricket.com](mailto:info@wclcricket.com) or choose “Privacy request” in the [contact form](/contact). Explain what you would like us to do; we may need proportionate information to verify your identity. Do not attach identity documents to an initial request. You may also raise a concern with the data-protection authority relevant to your location.

You can remove saved preferences using [browser storage controls](/cookies#controls). This does not remove an enquiry already sent to WCL. If a child has provided information without appropriate permission, a parent or guardian can contact us to ask for it to be reviewed.

sections.title: Contact and updates
sections.body: Questions about this notice or your information can be sent to [info@wclcricket.com](mailto:info@wclcricket.com). The date above identifies the current version. Material changes to how information is used should be reflected here and communicated separately where required.

pages.title: Cookies & storage
pages.intro: Clear information. Considered choices. Your WCL experience.

sections.title: What this website stores
sections.body:
Cookies and browser storage are small records used by websites. The public WCL website uses the following first-party browser preferences; these are not a mailing-list subscription or a fan account.

**wcl-fan**Local storage · your selected team and saved video IDs. Remains on this device until cleared.

**wcl-opening-seen**Session storage · remembers whether the opening sequence was shown. Cleared when the browser session ends.

The public website does not currently include an advertising pixel or an audience-analytics script in its application code. Hosting infrastructure can still keep request and security logs. Separate staff portals may use a necessary sign-in session cookie; their access and application notices apply separately.

sections.title: Media and external services
sections.body:
YouTube thumbnails load on pages that display them. Opening a WCL watch page loads a YouTube player, which can make requests to Google and use its own storage. Playback and sign-in preferences are controlled by YouTube.

Interactive maps connect to their map provider when loaded. Instagram cards open the original post on Instagram when selected. These services have their own cookies, privacy notices and controls. Closing an embedded player does not automatically delete storage already set by that provider.

When the contact service is enabled, Cloudflare Turnstile processes security signals to check whether a submission is genuine. The check is separate from marketing and is required to send through the form. You can use [info@wclcricket.com](mailto:info@wclcricket.com) instead.

Learn more at [Google’s cookie information](https://policies.google.com/technologies/cookies), [Instagram’s privacy notice](https://privacycenter.instagram.com/policy/) and [Cloudflare’s privacy notice](https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/).

sections.title: Your browser controls
sections.body:
Clear your WCL team and video preferences below. This affects this browser only; it does not delete messages you have sent, third-party cookies or information stored on another device.



Your browser’s privacy settings can remove site data, block third-party cookies or restrict storage. Blocking storage can prevent saved preferences from working; blocking external services can prevent videos, maps or security checks from loading.

For requests about information sent to WCL, see the [Privacy Policy](/privacy) or contact [info@wclcricket.com](mailto:info@wclcricket.com).

sections.body: This website provides WCL team, player, fixture, editorial and event information. You may browse and use its public features for lawful purposes. Using a separate ticketing, accreditation or other service may require additional terms displayed by that service.

sections.title: Content and ownership
sections.body:
WCL branding and website content, and the team crests, photographs, videos and other material appearing on the site, are subject to rights held by their respective owners or licensors. Their appearance does not transfer those rights to you.

You may share links to public pages. Reproduction, commercial distribution, modification or reuse of protected material requires the appropriate permission unless an applicable legal exception permits it. For permission enquiries or concerns about material on the site, contact [info@wclcricket.com](mailto:info@wclcricket.com) with the relevant page and details.

sections.title: Matches, tickets and third parties
sections.body:
Fixtures, venues, squads, start times and event arrangements can change. Check the latest event information and any confirmation from the relevant organiser or ticket seller before making travel or purchase decisions. Historical records and editorial material are not a guarantee about future participation or results.

Links to ticket sellers, broadcasters, map services and social platforms take you to services with their own terms, availability and privacy practices. A link or brand appearance is not, by itself, a promise about a current commercial relationship.

The contact form does not sell or reserve tickets and does not take payment. Purchase, admission, cancellation and refund conditions are provided by the relevant ticket seller and event organiser.

sections.title: Enquiries and responsible use
sections.body:
Provide accurate contact details and only information you are entitled to share. Do not submit unlawful, abusive, deceptive or malicious material; impersonate another person; attempt to bypass security; or disrupt access for others.

A form confirmation means the email service accepted your enquiry for delivery. It is not a ticket confirmation, accreditation approval, partnership acceptance or a guarantee of a response within a particular time. If delivery cannot be confirmed, use [info@wclcricket.com](mailto:info@wclcricket.com).

Access may be restricted where necessary to address misuse, protect the service or comply with law. Technical availability and third-party playback are not guaranteed.

sections.title: Your rights and changes
sections.body:
Nothing in these terms is intended to remove rights or exclude responsibilities that cannot lawfully be excluded. Applicable consumer and other mandatory protections continue to apply.

These terms may be updated as the website and its services change. Review the date at the top of this page. For questions about website use, contact [info@wclcricket.com](mailto:info@wclcricket.com). Personal information is handled as described in the [Privacy Policy](/privacy).
